qualifier: gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine lineages
name: Gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad and reproductive tract (uterus, oviduct, vagina, genitalia) and prostate morphogenesis plus pancreatic endocrine/exocrine progenitor lineages and adrenal development, unlike confusables centred on germ cells and seminiferous tubules, mammary gland or pancreatic ducts.

core: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-driven tissue repair
qualifier: fibrotic extracellular matrix and connective tissue replacement
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast-driven fibrotic tissue repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation and regeneration together with fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and ECM/collagen deposition in wound repair, distinguishing the theme from confusables about miRNA processing, ECM disassembly, sarcomere hypertrophy or core TGF-beta/SMAD signaling.

qualifier: inherited cytochrome P450 and transporter defects
name: Cholesterol-isoprenoid synthesis and inherited P450 and transporter defects
rationale: Members combine mevalonate/isoprenoid and Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis with Reactome diseases of defective CYPs and lipid/metabolite transporters, which sets the theme apart from bile acid synthesis, quinone/vitamin K and peroxisomal fatty acid confusables.

name: Cobalamin, thiamine, riboflavin and biotin transport and metabolism
rationale: All members concern uptake, transport and metabolism of B vitamins, dominated by cobalamin and its inherited defects, and the thiamine, riboflavin and biotin members distinguish it from the folate/methionine confusable as the cobalamin members do from CoA, quinone and methionine-salvage confusables.

qualifier: germ cell migration and proliferation control
name: Sperm function, fertilization and germ cell proliferation control
rationale: Members cover sperm structure, capacitation, motility, acrosome reaction, zona binding and egg activation plus primordial germ cell migration and germ cell proliferation, whereas confusables concern meiotic recombination, piRNA/zygotic genome control or gonadotropin and ovarian follicle regulation.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members describe PTK6 and ALK/LTK tyrosine kinase signaling, autophosphorylation and activation of PI3K/AKT and ERK cascades, distinguishing the theme from MET and ERBB family receptor confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK-family fusions and mutants
rationale: All members are cancer fusions, amplifications or activating mutants of FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK and LTK receptor kinases, unlike confusables covering EGFR/ERBB2 cancer variants, drug-resistant ALK mutants or normal PI3K/AKT signaling.

name: Proinflammatory monocyte activation, chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: Members concern monocyte activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation within the inflammatory cytokine/chemokine response, while confusables emphasise negative regulation of monocyte chemotaxis, CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte identity modules or resolution of inflammation.

name: Stress-induced CRH-ACTH-glucocorticoid secretion and fear response
rationale: Members cover CRH and ACTH signaling, glucocorticoid secretion and behavioral stress and fear responses, distinguishing the theme from confusables on social/drinking behaviors, opioid neuropeptide signaling or glucocorticoid receptor signaling regulation.

core: White adipocyte differentiation and triglyceride homeostasis
name: White adipogenesis and LXR-regulated triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members cover white fat cell differentiation, PPARG-driven adipogenesis and LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) control of triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on brown/beige thermogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis or SREBP and gluconeogenesis.

name: Glomerulus development and podocyte filtration barrier
rationale: Members concern development of glomerular mesangium, endothelium, basement membrane and podocytes (nephrin, podocyte migration) and glomerular filtration, distinguishing the theme from confusables on nephron tubule/ureteric bud development or brush border assembly.

qualifier: MYC-driven pre-rRNA cleavage and ribosome assembly
name: MYC-driven rRNA transcription, processing and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I elongation, pre-rRNA endonucleolytic cleavages, ribosome assembly and MYC target gene sets, unlike confusables on snoRNP-guided rRNA modification, Pol I initiation/chromatin control or mixed chromatin modules.

name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense at mucosal surfaces
rationale: Members cover alpha/beta defensins, antimicrobial peptide production, mucosal innate immunity and disruption of microbial cells and walls, distinguishing the theme from confusables on neutrophil killing, metal sequestration and antifungal responses.

name: Growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signaling and organismal growth
rationale: Members cover growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signaling, IGF receptor potentiation, leptin signaling and regulation of body growth, unlike confusables on prolactin, thyroid hormone, somatostatin/GHRH secretion or leptin-driven feeding behavior.

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan metabolism and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation or defects in its galactosyl-, sialyl- and sulfotransferases, distinguishing the theme from dystroglycan O-mannosylation, chondroitin/dermatan/heparan sulfate synthesis and mucopolysaccharidosis confusables.

name: PTK6 (BRK) tyrosine kinase signaling and effectors
rationale: Every member describes PTK6 expression, activation by ERBB2, regulation or its downstream targets, setting it apart from Hippo, ERBB, MET and ALK/PI3K signaling confusables.

name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover synthesis and protein attachment of GPI anchors and synthesis of glycosphingolipids, gangliosides and galactosylceramide, unlike confusables on nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, glycolipid transport or protein N-terminal lipidation.

name: AKT-regulated FOXO transcription and neuronal apoptosis
rationale: Members cover AKT phosphorylation, acetylation and localization control of FOXO factors and FOXO-driven death genes together with neuronal apoptosis and CDK5 neurodegeneration, which distinguishes the theme from NRF2, IGF response, UPR and heat-shock confusables.

core: Cullin neddylation and ubiquitin-dependent protein turnover
name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 deneddylation and ubiquitin-dependent turnover
rationale: Most members concern neddylation, COP9 signalosome deneddylation and cullin-ubiquitin degradation, with ubiquitination-enriched expression modules (one notably mitochondrial) attached, distinguishing the theme from RHOBTB, transcription-regulation and Fanconi anemia confusables.

qualifier: sleep-wake, mating, aggression and parental behavior
name: Neuropeptide regulation of sleep-wake and innate social behaviors
rationale: Members cover orexin/relaxin neuropeptide receptor signaling with sleep-wake regulation and innate behaviors (mating, parental, aggressive, drinking, stress), unlike confusables focused on HPA-axis glucocorticoid responses or opioid and dense-core vesicle synaptic signaling.

name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal innate signaling
rationale: Members cover Dectin-1, Dectin-2 family and DC-SIGN signaling, responses to fungal molecules and IL-23 production, distinguishing the theme from Th1/IL-12, IFN-gamma and IL-17 confusables.

name: HGF-MET receptor activation and downstream signaling
rationale: Members describe MET activation, recycling, inhibition and coupling to RAS, PI3K, STAT3, PTK2, RAP1/RAC1 and PTPN11, distinguishing the theme from PTK6, integrin adhesion, TGF-beta receptor mutant and ALK/PI3K confusables.

qualifier: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and phospholipid efflux
name: ABCA1-mediated HDL assembly and lipoprotein particle remodeling
rationale: Members cover HDL assembly via ABCA1 phospholipid efflux, apoA-I signaling and HDL/LDL particle remodeling, while confusables emphasise LXR-driven cholesterol efflux regulation, foam cells and HDL clearance.

name: Interferon-gamma response and Th1 cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover type II interferon signaling and its regulation, IL-12 JAK-STAT signaling, Th1 differentiation and MHC upregulation, distinguishing the theme from confusables on dendritic cell IL-12 production, Treg/Th17 regulation and antigen presentation.

name: Calcineurin phosphatase signaling in disuse muscle atrophy
rationale: Members cover calcineurin-NFAT and dephosphorylation regulation with skeletal muscle atrophy, inactivity and SCF-dependent proteolysis, unlike confusables on cardiac hypertrophy, sarcomere contraction, cell size or muscle regeneration.
